title: Agarose Gel Electrophoresis
author: Dana Mozaffari
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.78rhrv6
materials: Visualize the DNA fragments using a UV transilluminator.

steps.title: Prepare agarose solution
steps.instruction: Melt X% agarose (42 mg) in 42 mL 1X TAE buffer using a microwave until the solution becomes fully transparent.

steps.title: Add gel stain
steps.instruction: Add 3.5–4 µL Midori Green gel stain to the melted agarose and mix gently.

steps.title: Cast gel with comb
steps.instruction: Pour the stained agarose into the gel casting tray, insert the comb, and allow it to set.

steps.title: Allow gel to solidify
steps.instruction: Let the gel solidify for 30 minutes; cooling at 4 °C accelerates solidification.

steps.title: Cover gel and remove comb
steps.instruction: Add enough 1X TAE buffer to cover the gel surface and carefully remove the comb.

steps.title: Load samples into wells
steps.instruction: Load the DNA ladder and samples into the wells as described.

substeps.instruction: Load 5 µL of 1 kb DNA ladder into a well.
For each DNA sample, mix 5 µL of DNA with 1 µL of 6X loading buffer and load the mixture (total 6 µL) into a separate well.

steps.title: Run electrophoresis
steps.instruction: Run the gel at 100 V for 30 minutes, or at 110 V (adjust time) while ensuring bands do not run off the gel.

steps.title: Remove gel from apparatus
steps.instruction: Turn off power, open the chamber, and carefully lift the gel out.
